protocol_name: Differential dissipative-susceptibility prediction protocol v1.1.1 clarification
purpose: Clarify and supersede the v1.1 protocol before any holdout results are run, read, generated, or used. The v1.1.1 protocol freezes point prediction, joint-channel prediction, discrete first-flip definitions, C-index handling, classification denominator, and factor-of-two aggregation.

pair_universe.source: All 66 certified ordered path pairs from the v0.5.0 exact-root/open-system source artifacts.
pair_universe.notation: i>j denotes that certified path i is better than path j in the frozen unitary exact-root ordering.
pair_universe.diagnostic_pair_policy: Named diagnostic pairs are reported explicitly but do not determine PASS or FAIL.

training_data_policy.source: Use only v1.0 already public small-perturbation points.

formulas.single_channel_local_slope: For decay and dephasing separately, chi_ij = dD_ij/dlambda |_{lambda=0}, fitted only from public v1.0 lambdas {0, 1e-4, 3e-4}.
formulas.single_channel_predicted_first_flip_scal: lambda_pred_ij = Delta_ij / (-chi_ij); valid only when chi_ij < 0 and lambda_pred_ij > 0, otherwise no-crossing-on-positive-axis.
formulas.joint_additive_first_order_prediction: D_hat_ij(lambda_r, lambda_phi) = Delta_ij - chi_decay_ij * lambda_r - chi_dephasing_ij * lambda_phi
formulas.joint_positive_crossing_rule: The joint diagonal crossing is valid only when -(chi_decay_ij + chi_dephasing_ij) produces a positive finite lambda_pred_joint; otherwise label no-crossing-on-positive-axis.
formulas.actual_first_flip_scale: The actual first flip is the first point on the frozen discrete holdout grid at which the pair direction flips. It is not a claim about the continuous true crossing.

pair_direction_classification_accuracy.drop_policy: Do not remove any pair, channel family, or holdout condition.
pair_direction_classification_accuracy.joint_prediction: Use D_hat_ij(lambda_r, lambda_phi) = Delta_ij - chi_decay_ij * lambda_r - chi_dephasing_ij * lambda_phi.

actual_first_flip.definition: For each family and pair, scan only the frozen discrete holdout grid in ascending severity order and record the first grid point where the actual pair direction flips.
actual_first_flip.continuous_crossing_policy: Do not interpolate and do not report this as a continuous physical crossing.
actual_first_flip.right_censoring: If no flip appears on the frozen family grid, mark the pair as right-censored beyond that family grid maximum.

harrell_c_index.risk_score: Smaller finite predicted first-flip lambda means higher predicted flip risk. no-crossing-on-positive-axis is treated as right-censored at +infinity for prediction ordering.
comparable_pair_pairs: Within each family, compare unordered pairs of certified path pairs.
Two observed flips are comparable only when their discrete first-flip lambdas differ.
One observed flip and one observed right-censored pair are comparable, with the observed flip ordered earlier than the censored pair.
Two observed right-censored pairs are not comparable.
Equal observed first-flip lambdas are ties and are not included in the denominator.
harrell_c_index.prediction_ties: If a comparable example has equal predicted risk scores, assign 0.5 concordance credit.
harrell_c_index.concordant: A comparable example is concordant when the pair with earlier observed first flip has the smaller predicted first-flip scale, with no-crossing treated as +infinity.
harrell_c_index.family_c_index: family_concordance_credit / family_comparable_count when family_comparable_count > 0; otherwise null.
harrell_c_index.zero_family_denominator: A family with zero comparable pairs contributes 0 comparable pairs and 0 concordance credit to the pooled value.
harrell_c_index.primary_pooled_c_index: sum_family_concordance_credit / sum_family_comparable_count across decay, dephasing, and joint.
harrell_c_index.zero_pooled_denominator: If the pooled comparable-pair count is zero, the primary C-index gate fails.

factor_of_two_gate.eligible_pair_family: A pair-family item is eligible only if the pair actually flips on that family discrete holdout grid and the prediction has a positive finite lambda_pred for that family.
factor_of_two_gate.family_fraction: family_success_count / family_eligible_count when family_eligible_count > 0; otherwise null.
factor_of_two_gate.zero_family_eligible: A family with zero eligible items contributes 0 successes and 0 eligible items to the pooled value.
factor_of_two_gate.primary_pooled_fraction: sum_family_success_count / sum_family_eligible_count across decay, dephasing, and joint.
factor_of_two_gate.zero_pooled_eligible: If the pooled eligible denominator is zero, the primary factor-of-two gate fails.

classification_rules.failure_reporting: Report all failed gates, all pair-family no-crossing labels, all observed flips, all censored pair-family items, and both named diagnostic pairs. Do not select only successful pairs.

solver_environment.equation: QuTiP Lindblad/GKSL density-matrix propagation matching open-system v1.0

non_claims: This v1.1.1 clarification protocol does not run, read, or reveal holdout results.
This protocol supersedes v1.1 before holdout execution by freezing execution semantics only.
This protocol does not modify Arb/Krawczyk proof engines, exact-root boxes, or earlier certificates.
This protocol is not an Arb interval proof.
This protocol is not calibrated PASQAL hardware noise and is not PASQAL Cloud, FRESNEL, or QPU evidence.
The differential dissipative-susceptibility mechanism remains a post-hoc v1.1 hypothesis until this frozen holdout protocol is executed.

canonicalization.hash_exclusion: The canonical_protocol_sha256 field is removed before hashing.
